name: Quebrada Blanca copper mine area, Tarapacá, Chile
default_claim: The mining operation at this site stopped expanding after 2019.
description: High-altitude open-pit copper operation in the Atacama. Pre-scouted with real Sentinel-2 L2A scenes (Nov 2019 vs Nov 2023, both cloud-free over the AOI); candidate surface disturbances appear around waste dumps, pit walls and a new linear feature.
location_source: Mine location per Wikipedia 'Quebrada Blanca' (−21.0043, −68.8010); AOI centre is ~2 km north, inside the 6 km AOI.

name: Bingham Canyon open-pit mine, Utah, USA
default_claim: The Bingham Canyon pit has not expanded since 2019.
description: Large, long-established open pit. Summer 2019 vs summer 2024; real scenes show localised changes inside the existing pit and on its walls.
location_source: Mine location per Wikipedia 'Bingham Canyon Mine' (40.523, −112.151).

name: Southwestern Amazon frontier site, Brazil (−9.54, −65.93)
default_claim: No forest was cleared in this area after 2020.
description: Located by a 20 km wide scan of real dry-season imagery (Jul 2020 vs Jul 2023) for forest-like canopy loss. Mix of forest, pasture and newly bare ground.
location_source: Coordinates chosen from imagery (no named site claimed).

name: Southern Amazonas forest control site, Brazil (−8.25, −66.95)
default_claim: This forest area has remained intact since 2020.
description: Continuous canopy in the pre-scout (Jul 2020 vs Jul 2024): no candidate loss regions were found. Included as a control where a no-clearing claim can be tested.
location_source: Coordinates chosen from imagery (no named site claimed).
